entries.text: A chain's upstream can be filled in from one pasted line, and three dialer loops that made the core reject the whole config are now caught
The chain page has an add button, and a profile with no groups gets one so the chain it creates actually reaches the config
A chain's upstream can be picked from a subscription, creating a group that carries it so a node of that sub is reachable as the upstream
A chain's upstream can be typed in as type, address, port and account, creating the proxy for you; a typed upstream is declared in the config even when no group names it
v1.0.1 notes describe the proxy chain view and the dropped dangling dialer

The custom profile dialer page is now a proxy chain view showing exit and upstream addresses, and a dialer naming a proxy the config does not declare is dropped instead of making the core reject the whole config
builds up to 1.0.11 read GuLiang-I/GLClash, which is suspended, so they cannot see this release and must be downloaded by hand.
Serve updates from GitHub with Codeberg as the standby
